candidates.name: Apex Doors (Apex Doors OK)
candidates.partition_evidence: Dedicated 'Bathroom Partitions Contractor in Tulsa' Division 10 page describes commercial and ADA toilet partition installation (site assessment, mounting, inspection) in powder-coated steel, HDPE, stainless, phenolic and laminate. Homepage says it supplies and installs commercial restroom partitions.
red_flags: Sells partitions itself ('Purchase durable toilet partitions ... from Apex Doors'): a buy-around risk
No named projects or captioned project photos; mainly a commercial door company
No aggregate Google rating shown on the site, only two testimonials
candidates.reason: Tulsa-based commercial door and Division 10 contractor with a dedicated toilet partition installation page that lists Broken Arrow, Owasso, Bixby and Jenks among the areas it serves. It also sells partitions, so a listing agreement would need to address substitution.

license.name: Apex Doors (Apex Doors OK)
license.registry: City of Tulsa Development Services Permit Center contractor registration (EnerGov Self-Service Portal, https://tulsaok-energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/selfservice); state: Oklahoma Construction Industries Board does not license this work
license.note: Oklahoma has no state license for partition or general contractor work. CIB licenses trades only. Tulsa requires contractor registration with the Permit Center, but the city publishes no public list of registered contractors. Its EnerGov Self-Service Portal is JavaScript-only, shows Log In / Register, and returned no public contractor search to automated access. Checked 2026-11-19. Confirm registration by phone with the Permit Center, 918-596-9456 (listed in search results for the city contact page). No license number was found.

candidates.name: Murray Womble, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage has a 'Bathroom Partitions & Accessories' section (metal, plastic laminate and plastic partitions) and says the company 'provided and installed architectural specialty products'. The About page says 'we often install what we sell'. No page states toilet partition installation outright.
red_flags: Distributor of architectural hardware and specialties that sells partitions: a buy-around risk
No explicit partition installation project or photo found
candidates.reason: Long-established (founded in Tulsa in 1922) commercial hardware and specialties supplier with offices in Owasso and Oklahoma City that lists partitions and says it installs what it sells. Partition installation is likely but not shown directly.

license.name: Murray Womble, Inc.
license.registry: City of Tulsa Development Services Permit Center contractor registration (EnerGov Self-Service Portal); state: Oklahoma Construction Industries Board does not license this work

Confirm with the Tulsa Permit Center, and with the city where the job is (for example Owasso). No license number was found.
